details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:387-390 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In release_blocker_check_stale, `rb_gate_runs_on_tip` counts every gate run on the tip (`select(.head_sha == $sha and .head_branch == $branch)`) whatever its status or conclusion, so a cancelled run makes the guard return early and suppresses stable_release_stale.
  WHY: Cancelled runs are left out of failed_attempts_on_tip (lines 525-528) and are not active, so neither last_gate_failed nor release_in_flight reports them; a tip whose gates keep being cancelled and retried can stay stale past RELEASE_BLOCKER_STABLE_STALE_SECS for days with no heal report while those runs remain in the 30-run window (all MAJOR; sonnet confidence 3, citing plan line 58's literal wording "no gate run started on the tip since").
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:425-429 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The stale-report guard suppresses reporting whenever any gate run exists on the current tip, regardless of its conclusion.
  WHY: Cancelled gate runs are excluded from the failed-attempt budget and retried, so they keep the guard (rb_gate_runs_on_tip) non-zero and suppress the stale release report indefinitely while the release is stuck.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:416-423 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `rb_last_gate` jq at line 416, the read at line 417 and the `last_gate_on_tip=` / `conclusion=` evidence fields at line 423 are dead code, because execution only gets past the guard when there are zero gate runs on the tip, so the lookup always comes back empty.
  WHY: Every stale report writes the constant `last_gate_on_tip=none conclusion=none` and costs a jq subprocess that does nothing (minimax also filed this separately as a performance cost); the evidence implies a lookup happened when it never can.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:457-463 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The stale release age calculation takes the minimum age instead of the maximum age between the tag and commit dates.
  WHY: A 30-day-old tag with a 1-day-old latest commit reads as 1 day old, so the tag's staleness goes unreported for 29 days beyond the threshold (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this as a false positive at lines 406-412).
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:210-229 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On timeout, release_blocker_alert's `pkill -P "${release_blocker_alert_pid}"` signals only direct children, so the curl that `tg_send_msg` runs inside a command substitution (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:131-134) is a grandchild and survives.
  WHY: A stalled Telegram POST outlives the 30-second timeout and holds a socket, with TG_BOT_SECRET in its argv, until the Actions job is torn down; the suggested fix is `setsid` plus `kill -- -"${pid}"` (all NIT; confidence 3/3/4).
- README.md:281-283 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The RELEASE_BLOCKER_GATE_FAILED_MIN_AGE_SECS row still says "That run goes in the report's `run_refs`", and the RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_ENABLED row still says "`stable_release_stale` only when neither reported"; the script no longer matches either statement.
  WHY: scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:362-365 leaves run_refs empty for `startup_failure`, and :387-390 also requires zero gate runs on the tip, so operators would treat correct behaviour as a bug.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fragment still says "(that run goes in `run_refs`)" and "`stable_release_stale`, evaluated only when neither of those reported".
  WHY: After the fragment is folded into agents.md it publishes a contract that disagrees with scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:362-365 and :387-390.
- changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog entry claims "(`last_gate_failed`, with the failed gate run in `run_refs`)", and it leaves out the rule that stale reporting is suppressed whenever any gate run exists on the tip.
  WHY: The script omits the run for `startup_failure` conclusions (scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:362-365), so the release notes describe a different report shape from the one the script emits.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:387-390 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: In release_blocker_check_stale, rb_gate_runs_on_tip counts every gate run on the tip (`select(.head_sha == $sha and .head_branch == $branch)`) whatever its status or conclusion, so a cancelled run turns off stable_release_stale; lines 525-528 leave `cancelled` out of failed_attempts_on_tip, and a completed cancelled run is not in flight.
  WHY: With repeated cancellations (the plan's incident at docs/plans/release-blocker-heal-reports-plan.md:171), each tick takes the dispatch path (line 542) and returns without a report, which breaks the success metric in docs/plans/remove-unattended-pipeline-stuck-states-plan.md; the minimal fix is `and .conclusion != "cancelled"` in the line-387 jq. Caveat: plan line 58 ("no gate run started on the tip since") supports the current code if read literally.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:416-417, 423 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rb_last_gate jq only runs after the guard has confirmed zero gate runs on the tip, so it always comes back empty and rb_last_id and rb_last_conclusion are always empty.
  WHY: Every report carries the constant `last_gate_on_tip=none conclusion=none`; the fix for the cancelled-run finding resolves this too, otherwise drop the lookup.
- README.md (RELEASE_BLOCKER_GATE_FAILED_MIN_AGE_SECS and RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_ENABLED rows), agents.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md line 2, changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md line 2 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docs say the failed run goes in run_refs and that stale is evaluated only when neither other reporter fired, but lines 362-365 now claim the run only for `failure`/`timed_out`, and lines 387-390 suppress stale whenever any gate run exists on the tip.
  WHY: The documented contract no longer matches the script, so operators would treat correct behaviour as a bug; the agents.d and changelog.d text will be folded in unchanged.
- Rejected pass-1 item: the gemini finding at scripts/auto_release_stable.sh lines 406-412 ("takes the minimum age instead of the maximum") is wrong, because pending_since = max(tag time, oldest unreleased commit date), the smaller age is correct, and test_stable_release_stale_ignores_a_fresh_patch_on_an_old_tag checks exactly this.
- HARDENING: scripts/auto_release_stable.sh release_blocker_check_stale, line 387-390 — if runs_json does not parse, rb_gate_runs_on_tip is empty and the function returns silently; echo `RELEASE_BLOCKER_REPORT_SKIPPED reason=guard_unavailable blocker=stable_release_stale lookup=gate_runs` (~3 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/auto_release_stable.sh release_blocker_alert, lines 210-229 — `pkill -P` may leave the curl grandchild (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:131) running with the bot token in its argv; use `setsid` or a scoped `set -m` and `kill -- -"${release_blocker_alert_pid}"` (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:425-429 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The stale-report guard suppresses reporting whenever any gate run exists on the current tip, regardless of its conclusion.
  WHY: Repeatedly cancelled gate runs, which are excluded from the failed-attempt budget and retried, keep the guard (rb_gate_runs_on_tip) non-zero and suppress the stale release report indefinitely.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:457-463 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stale release age calculation takes the minimum age instead of the maximum age between the tag and commit dates.
  WHY: A 30-day-old tag with a 1-day-old commit is reported as 1 day old, so the tag's staleness is ignored for 29 days beyond the threshold.
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:416-423 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `rb_last_gate` jq call and the evidence fields (last_gate_on_tip, conclusion) are dead code, because the guard at line 428 always returns early if a gate run exists.
  WHY: The dead code returns constant, misleading evidence (none/none).
- scripts/auto_release_stable.sh:218-220 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Telegram timeout branch's `pkill -P` on the background PID does not reach grandchild processes.
  WHY: tg_send_msg runs curl inside a command substitution, so the curl is a grandchild and keeps running until job-end cleanup.
- README.md:282-283 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docs for RELEASE_BLOCKER_HEAL_ENABLED and RELEASE_BLOCKER_GATE_FAILED_MIN_AGE_SECS are outdated.
  WHY: They claim `startup_failure` runs go in run_refs (they do not), and they leave out that stale reporting now depends on whether any gate run exists on the tip.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md:2 and changelog.d/stuck-states-p4-rb-auto-release-reporters.md:2 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The fragment and changelog descriptions are outdated.
  WHY: They still claim `startup_failure` runs are tracked in run_refs, and they leave out the rule that stable_release_stale is suppressed whenever any gate run exists on the tip.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
